_about: Team rulings on conflicts inside brand.json (decided 2026-11-16). brand.json stays verbatim; build-tokens.ts applies these on top. Nothing here adds a new size, colour or spacing; each entry resolves a conflict or derives a value from brand.json.

notes_override_component_spec.page_title: Numbered chapter plus accent rule in section colour (notes.title).
notes_override_component_spec.subheading: Vertical bar in section colour plus numbered capital label (caption size, tracked 0.12em, section colour) above an h2 (notes.sub).
notes_override_component_spec.key_figure_source: Source and base sit small (caption size, muted) in the lower part of the tile. Numbered footnotes are kept for numbers in running text and charts (notes.source).
notes_override_component_spec.page_furniture: Top tab and a vertical section strip on the outer edge, for navigation (notes.furn).

spacing.block_gap_reason: brand.json says 30, which is off the 4 px grid; the team ruled 32.
spacing.margin_reason: 794 px pages are not a multiple of 4. The grid is measured from the spine; inner margins stay 96 on both sides of the spine (notes.density) and the 2 px slack goes to the outer margins. Content width 600, columns 284.
spacing.content_height_reason: Vertical grid measured from the top edge: content runs 96 to 1024 (the last grid line inside the 96 px bottom margin); the 3 px slack goes to the bottom margin.
spacing.hairline_reason: Thinnest rule (tables, footnote separator, contents rows). The only rule weight below the 4 px unit; row heights compensate so blocks stay on the grid.

typography.line_height_reason: Body 15 x 1.62 = 24.3 snapped to 24 (team ruling). Text roles (lead, caption) use 1.62 snapped to the nearest 4 px; display roles (display, key figure, h1, h2) use the smallest 4 px multiple of at least 1.1 x size.

color.darken_rule: Each step multiplies R, G and B by 0.9. Applied for white text on section colour (brand.json) and, by team ruling, for section colour used as text on paper or on the 10% tile, until 4.5:1 is reached.
color.rule_dark: Chart 'rule-dark grey' = rule colour darkened by one 10% step.

pdf: One PDF page per spread (1588 x 1123 px). Page numbers count A4 pages: spread n holds pages 2n-1 and 2n.
toc: A contents spread at the start of the report, and chapter contents in each section divider, all with real page numbers.
